snippet.title: The Myth of a Godslayer - Trailer
snippet.description:
Follow Klain's mythical adventures in this top-down Action-RPG game mixing combat, exploration, puzzles and platforming. Travel through the New World, explore forgotten dungeons, confront terrible foes and... become a Godslayer! 

Steam (demo available): https://store.steampowered.com/app/3817260/The_Myth_of_a_Godslayer/
Discord: https://discord.gg/zysacZ4QZm
